title: ר' שמעון בן <small>(רב)</small> זביד
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: R' Shimon son of (Rav) Zevid, in R' Yitzhak Tavla's name, who said in R' Hiyya the Tall's name, of R' Aha's house, who said in R' Zeira's name, who said in R' Elazar's name, who said in R' Hanina's name, who said in R' Meyasha's name, in R' Yehudah bar Illai's name: Nedarim, first chapter, 8b. His brother was a great man and expert in blessings; he visited R' Zeira. See Rav Zevid.
